lines.item: SHNITPWR 24 V DC 5 A 120 W power supply for the iron (5.5 x 2.5 mm plug)
lines.check: Set the kit's multimeter to DC volts. Red probe on the centre pin of the plug, black on the outer barrel, adapter in the wall. About +24 V means centre-positive; a minus sign means reversed. The iron's own polarity is not confirmed: if it is marked differently, do not plug it in. The box label should say 5 A.

backup.note: 24 V 3 A, 5.5 x 2.5 mm. Not bought: Abra's freight was CA$28.75 on 3 Nov.

lines.item: M3 x 10 mm black steel button-head screws, 10 pack (for the 4 rubber feet)

backup.note: M3 x 10 8-pack, out of stock on 3 Nov. Its description says 12 mm while the title says 10 mm: check before ordering.

lines.note: M3 x 10 (Shad, 3 Nov; Fable N8): the rubber foot is 6.3 mm tall, so a 10 mm screw leaves about 3.7 mm of thread in the standoff. FlyFishRC 12.9-grade steel, choose the M3x10 option.

4: Check on arrival [REQUIRES REAL INPUT]: (a) the knurled standoffs are assumed to be threaded at both ends (female); (b) the foot screws are M3 x 10 mm (6.3 mm foot + about 3.7 mm of thread): check they hold the foot.
